name: liquidity-pool-performance-benchmarks
description: A dataset and evaluation suite for measuring predictive and analytical performance on decentralized finance (DeFi) liquidity pools, including throughput, slippage, impermanent loss estimation, and yield dynamics. It provides time-series and snapshot features for pools and traders, enabling models to be evaluated on forecasting, anomaly detection, and strategy-ranking tasks. Benchmarks focus on real-world pool behavior across different AMM protocols and market regimes.
reputation: Niche dataset within DeFi and crypto research with modest community adoption for liquidity-performance modeling.
